climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Riesling sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: One of the cooler Australian regions, in the Western Victoria area in the southwest corner of the state, formerly called Drumborg. It is known for white Chardonnay, Riesling, Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc, though Pinot Noir is the most planted grape at 40 percent.
